propositions: _build_datacenter and _build_cloud are asymmetric: _build_cloud asserts scope readiness at build time but _build_datacenter defers all validation to lazy _LazyDataCenterClient
assert_cloud_scope_ready enforces stricter validation (email-format JIRA_USER, non-empty project) than the legacy ambient assert_env_ready, and this tightening is undocumented
New assert_datacenter_nonsecret_scope_ready must validate base_url and jira.project at build time in _build_datacenter while keeping PAT and network validation lazy in _LazyDataCenterClient
assert_cloud_scope_ready and JiraBackend.assert_env_ready docstrings must document that the email-format and non-empty-project checks are intentionally stricter than legacy, not accidental drift
DC backend composition must remain possible without JIRA_PAT and without the [agents] jira extra at build time, with validation deferred to lazy client
Unit tests must verify fail-closed behavior for empty base_url and empty jira.project raising BackendEnvError, and lazy-preserved behavior for DC builds without JIRA_PAT
